description: Default operation targets of the aesthetic plan emitter: per design operator, the fixed targets, graph-derived gains and secondary parameters it emits into the execution plan (subject PLAN_<operator id>), the neutral graph readings used when evidence is absent, and the tolerance of the plan's conflict resolution.

rules.title: Plan emitter: neutral graph readings when a node or relation is absent

payload.subject: PLAN_GRAPH_FALLBACKS
payload.rationale: Readings the plan emitter assumes when the relationship graph has no node of a type (void, subject, boundary, light, material) or no relation of a type (solid-void, host-guest, dense-sparse). Migrated unchanged from design-compiler; the source records no rationale for the values.

rules.title: Plan emission of OP_ENCLOSE_BREATHING_FIELD: negative-space target and aggregation

payload.subject: PLAN_OP_ENCLOSE_BREATHING_FIELD
payload.rationale: Target negative space = measured VOID energy + negative_space_lift, kept inside the effective void_ratio band of the context (ADR-0001 rule 6: operator clamps take their bounds from the period band; replaces the fixed clamp of the original emitter). aggregation_base is added to the SOLID_VOID magnitude; transition_softness is a fixed secondary parameter. Lift, base and softness are migrated unchanged.

rules.title: Plan emission of OP_ALIGN_GUEST_HOST_TENSION: focal offset target

payload.subject: PLAN_OP_ALIGN_GUEST_HOST_TENSION
payload.rationale: Target focal offset = focal_offset_base + HOST_GUEST magnitude * focal_offset_gain; the host and guest weights follow the SUBJECT energy and its complement (structural, not a decision). Migrated unchanged from the design-compiler plan emitter.

rules.title: Plan emission of OP_PARTITION_POISSON_CLUSTER: minimum distance and iterations

payload.subject: PLAN_OP_PARTITION_POISSON_CLUSTER
payload.rationale: Cluster density target follows the DENSE_SPARSE magnitude (structural); minimum distance = min_distance_base + (1 - density) * min_distance_gain; iterations is a fixed secondary parameter emitted with the plan. Migrated unchanged from the design-compiler plan emitter.

rules.title: Plan emission of OP_CALIBRATE_AXIAL_ORDER: axis tolerance

payload.subject: PLAN_OP_CALIBRATE_AXIAL_ORDER
payload.rationale: The axial symmetry target follows the BOUNDARY energy (structural); axis_tolerance is the fixed tolerance emitted with it. Migrated unchanged from the design-compiler plan emitter.

rules.title: Plan emission of OP_LAYER_DEPTH_RECESSION: default depth layers, recession rate and haze start

payload.subject: PLAN_OP_LAYER_DEPTH_RECESSION
payload.rationale: Period-independent plan defaults of the layering operator (depth layers, recession_rate and haze_start are fixed values), as in the original emitter. The operator's own per-period layer table is a separate decision (CAS-OP-LAYER-DEPTH) and is not merged here. Migrated unchanged; the source records no rationale for the values.

rules.title: Plan emission of OP_INJECT_ATMOSPHERIC_VOID: density gain and falloff

payload.subject: PLAN_OP_INJECT_ATMOSPHERIC_VOID
payload.rationale: Target atmospheric density = VOID energy * density_gain; falloff_exponent is a fixed secondary parameter emitted with it. Migrated unchanged from the design-compiler plan emitter.

rules.title: Plan emission of OP_SHIFT_HORIZON_PROPORTION: default horizon position

payload.subject: PLAN_OP_SHIFT_HORIZON_PROPORTION
payload.rationale: Period-independent default horizon position of the plan and the transition band emitted with it. Migrated unchanged from the design-compiler plan emitter; the source records no rationale for the values.

rules.title: Plan emission of OP_FRAME_SECONDARY_OCCLUSION: default occlusion ratio

payload.subject: PLAN_OP_FRAME_SECONDARY_OCCLUSION
payload.rationale: Period-independent default occlusion ratio of the plan and the softness emitted with it. Migrated unchanged from the design-compiler plan emitter; the source records no rationale for the values.

rules.title: Plan emission of OP_APPLY_TIME_PATINA: patina gain and distribution

payload.subject: PLAN_OP_APPLY_TIME_PATINA
payload.rationale: Target patina level = MATERIAL energy * patina_gain; patina_distribution is the distribution mode emitted with it. Migrated unchanged from the design-compiler plan emitter.

rules.title: Plan emission of OP_DAMPEN_SPECULAR_HARSHNESS: default specular sharpness

payload.subject: PLAN_OP_DAMPEN_SPECULAR_HARSHNESS
payload.rationale: Period-independent default specular sharpness of the plan (on the 0-100 runtime scale) and the dampening factor emitted with it. Migrated unchanged from the design-compiler plan emitter; the source records no rationale for the values.

rules.title: Plan emission of OP_ORCHESTRATE_MATERIAL_CONTRAST: default contrast ratio

payload.subject: PLAN_OP_ORCHESTRATE_MATERIAL_CONTRAST
payload.rationale: Period-independent default material contrast ratio of the plan and the balance emitted with it. Migrated unchanged from the design-compiler plan emitter; the source records no rationale for the values.

rules.title: Plan emission of OP_WEATHER_SURFACE_ENTROPY: entropy gain and scale

payload.subject: PLAN_OP_WEATHER_SURFACE_ENTROPY
payload.rationale: Target surface entropy = MATERIAL energy * entropy_gain; entropy_scale is a fixed secondary parameter emitted with it. Migrated unchanged from the design-compiler plan emitter.

rules.title: Plan emission of OP_HARMONIZE_SKY_LUMINANCE: luminance gain

payload.subject: PLAN_OP_HARMONIZE_SKY_LUMINANCE
payload.rationale: Target sky luminance = LIGHT energy * luminance_gain; harmonization_factor is a fixed secondary parameter emitted with it. Migrated unchanged from the design-compiler plan emitter.

rules.title: Plan emission of OP_COOL_SHADOW_CHROMATICITY: default shadow temperature

payload.subject: PLAN_OP_COOL_SHADOW_CHROMATICITY
payload.rationale: Period-independent default shadow temperature of the plan and the cooling strength emitted with it. Migrated unchanged from the design-compiler plan emitter; the source records no rationale for the values.

rules.title: Plan emission of OP_FILTER_MIST_SCATTER: mist density gain and anisotropy

payload.subject: PLAN_OP_FILTER_MIST_SCATTER
payload.rationale: Target mist density = VOID energy * density_gain; scatter_anisotropy is a fixed secondary parameter emitted with it. Migrated unchanged from the design-compiler plan emitter.

rules.title: Plan emission of OP_RESTRICT_ACCENT_LUMINANCE: default accent luminance

payload.subject: PLAN_OP_RESTRICT_ACCENT_LUMINANCE
payload.rationale: Period-independent default accent luminance of the plan and the restriction threshold emitted with it. Migrated unchanged from the design-compiler plan emitter; the source records no rationale for the values.

rules.title: Plan conflict resolution: tolerance of the interval-intersection merge

payload.subject: PLAN_CONFLICT_TOLERANCE
payload.rationale: When operators propose different values for one parameter, each proposal widens to an interval of +- relative tolerance (never less than the absolute tolerance); intersecting intervals merge to their midpoint, otherwise the category priority (CAS-GOV-001) decides. Migrated unchanged from the design-compiler conflict resolver.
